ios.desc:
The last AI iOS app you'll need! Pal Chat is a lightweight, powerful, and feature-rich AI Chat Client for your iPhone.

It supports EVERY AI model in one interface, including support for: GPT-5.5, Claude 4.7, Gemini 3.1, Grok 4.3, Cursor, Advanced Voice Mode, Image input, GPT-Image 2, Groq, Perplexity, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, Fal.ai, Together.ai, custom endpoints, and fully offline local models.

No ads, fully private and secure - NO data is collected.

Features Overview:
- Save multiple prompts and system messages
- Store conversation history on-device
- Use Image input to process images
- Generate images through GPT-Image, Stable Diffusion, Flux, or Fal.ai
- Regenerate responses
- Edit your questions
- Stream the response
- Easily switch between models
- See the token length and cost of the conversation
- Copy an entire conversation from the history page
- Full Markdown, LaTeX, and Syntax Highlighting Support
- Siri Shortcuts Support

Some Benefits of the App over the website:
- No usage limits
- Privacy - History is only stored on-device
- Lets you edit the system message and temperature values
- Universal - easily switch many different models

Make sure to get an API Key!

‘Pal’ is not liable for any content generated.

Terms of Use: https://bit.ly/termsOfUsePalChatEULA
Privacy Policy: https://bit.ly/privacyPolicyPalChatEULA

quotes.text:
I wanted a way to interact with GPT-4 Turbo and DALL·E 3 without having to pay a minimum of $20 for ChatGPT Plus - so I made this iOS wrapper client to achieve just that.

It's powered by your own API Key so there's no backend, and it also supports on-device conversation history.

It started off with GPT-4 but now also support Claude 2.1 and Gemini Pro with their respective API Keys.

Another very useful aspect is that you can choose to use the older GPT-4 models to see how they compare to the newer, allegedly nerfed, models.

Hope people find this useful!
